problem: Asset acquisition transaction/lifecycle activities (specify, procure, receive, commission, capitalise) are overloaded onto the asset identity aggregate.
required_outcome: Separate governed acquisition/procurement/commissioning process identities while preserving canonical Asset identity and provenance.

problem: Construction / Project Delivery design, permit, construct, inspect, commission and handover activities are represented as property acquisition.
required_outcome: Map project delivery to Project/Work Package/Information/Inspection/Commissioning/Handover aggregates with Asset/Property as context or outcome.

problem: Operational/legal lease identity, obligations, renewals and termination are conflated with accounting measurement.
required_outcome: Establish canonical Lease/Occupancy/Property-interest identity separate from lease-accounting measurement and postings.

problem: Disposal must not destroy canonical asset history.
required_outcome: Replace deletion semantics with retire/dispose/decommission/effective-end lifecycle while retaining immutable history and evidence.

problem: Safety framework, hazard assessment, inspection, incident, occupational health and permit-to-work are materially different governed objects but share one incident aggregate/object family.
required_outcome: Define linked but distinct H&S policy/framework, hazard/risk assessment, inspection, incident, occupational-health and permit aggregates/objects.

problem: Occupational-health/surveillance information can contain sensitive worker health data and cannot share ordinary incident/permit access and retention semantics.
required_outcome: Create dedicated occupational-health record boundary with purpose-limited access, retention, audit and disclosure controls.

problem: Carbon accounting, energy management, sustainability strategy and ESG disclosure have different truth, lifecycle and assurance semantics.
required_outcome: Separate or explicitly model linked Carbon, Energy, Sustainability Strategy and ESG Disclosure/Reporting objects while retaining shared metrics where appropriate.

problem: Environmental aspects/impacts/controls and environmental compliance obligations are conflated.
required_outcome: Model environmental management/aspects/impacts/controls separately from external compliance requirements, permits, returns and findings.

problem: Financial strategy, budgeting, rolling forecast, commercial profitability and capital-investment approval are different governed truths but share one broad object.
required_outcome: Separate Budget, Forecast, Financial Planning/Scenario, Profitability Analysis and Capital Investment Request/Approval objects with controlled relationships.

problem: Ledger postings, close process, consolidation, financial-report outputs and control certification have different lifecycle/evidence semantics.
required_outcome: Keep immutable ledger truth separate from Close, Consolidation Run, Reporting Snapshot/Statement and Financial Control/Certification objects.

problem: Cash positions, bank accounts, payment runs, FX exposures/hedges and debt facilities/covenants are materially different treasury objects.
required_outcome: Define linked treasury objects for Cash Position/Bank Account, Payment Run/Instruction, FX Exposure/Hedge and Debt Facility/Covenant.

problem: Capex request, evaluation, approval, spend tracking and benefits review are treated as fields/actions on a budget object.
required_outcome: Create a governed Capital Investment Request/Decision lifecycle linked to Budget, Project/Asset, Decision and Ledger outcomes.

current_model: Journal post; Payment create/approve/transmit; Financial control certification
problem: The activity catalogue does not by itself prove maker-checker, journal approval, payment segregation or control-certifier independence.
required_outcome: Model explicit authority and SoD policies for journal preparation/approval/posting, payment preparation/approval/transmission, reconciliations and control certification.

current_model: AGG-03-ACCOUNT-PLAN / Sales / Account Plan / Account / Partner Plan
problem: Enterprise sales strategy/territories/quotas, customer account plans, partner plans and sales-performance outcomes have different lifecycle and subject semantics.
required_outcome: Separate Sales Strategy/Territory/Quota, Account Plan, Partner Plan and Sales Performance Snapshot concepts while preserving shared customer/party references.

problem: Individual opportunity truth, pipeline aggregation and sales forecast/scenario are conflated.
required_outcome: Keep Opportunity as transactional truth; model Pipeline and Sales Forecast as governed aggregate/snapshot/scenario views with explicit as-of/version semantics.

problem: Sales incentive definition, commission calculation and payment approval require explicit maker/checker and payroll/finance handoff semantics.
required_outcome: Define compensation-plan versioning, calculation run, exception approval and payment-authority separation linked to payroll/finance.

problem: Procurement strategy, category planning and procurement analytics are different governed outputs but share one package object.
required_outcome: Separate Procurement Strategy, Category Plan and Procurement Analytics/Snapshot semantics while linking them to sourcing packages/events.

problem: Supplier discovery, due diligence/onboarding/activation and ongoing relationship management are distinct lifecycle processes but share a generic relationship object.
required_outcome: Model Supplier Candidate/Qualification, Onboarding/Due-Diligence Case and Supplier Relationship separately while retaining one canonical Party/Organisation identity.

problem: Requisition conversion and PO approval/issue must preserve distinct requester/buyer/approver authority and commitment thresholds.
required_outcome: Define explicit procurement authority/SoD policy, approval thresholds and immutable commitment issue/amendment history.
